sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent form. Sandbach are 1st with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, maintaining a strong run that includes four wins in their last five outings. They face bottom-of-the-table Alsager Town, who sit on just 4 points and have lost their last four games, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be heavy favourites to maintain their title challenge.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture with title-race implications given their 2-point gap behind leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall in a top-half collision, with both teams in strong form—AFC Bridgnorth have won four of their last five while Eccleshall have won three in a row. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter between two teams capable of climbing the standings. Bilston Town's visit to Foley Meir sees another mid-table clash with both sides showing decent recent form. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in a bottom-half battle, while Shawbury United face Barnton in a fixture involving a struggling side against a more consistent outfit. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a clash between two teams with patchy recent records. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town in what amounts to a contest between two of the division's weakest performers, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in another fixture at the lower end of the table.
